card.name: Prohibition and exclusion words
card.fires_on: Words about forbidding or excluding, such as forbid, prohibition, proscription, barred, off limits, and the robots exclusion standard (robots.txt). It fires on the word itself or partway through it.

modes.label: Forbidding words
modes.description: Words meaning forbid, ban or taboo in religious, legal or dietary settings.
